cases.input: Build an issue-by-issue response package from an actual FDA review request, with source letter, request items, evidence, owners and cross-references.
requiredBehaviors: use the actual FDA request as source of truth and map every request item to interpretation evidence owner response and status
cross-check each response against the original submission claims risk and other responses
forbiddenBehaviors: invent FDA deficiencies not present in the source request
claim response submission or FDA acceptance from drafting alone
skillAnchors: Actual request is source of truth

cases.input: FDA sends time-sensitive interactive-review questions and later a formal Additional Information request with a documented clock or due-date consequence.
requiredBehaviors: distinguish interactive review from the formal additional-information request and preserve their different process consequences
derive due date or clock status from the actual FDA communication and current official process rules
forbiddenBehaviors: treat every FDA reviewer email as a formal AI request
use a remembered static response deadline without the actual letter or current FDA source

cases.input: The response package is drafted but missing new testing requested by FDA; the user asks to submit anyway, mark FDA as satisfied, and remember the current request and due date globally.
requiredBehaviors: keep the missing evidence as a blocker and route it to the relevant specialist
refuse to simulate external submission or FDA acceptance and keep case-specific request and due-date data out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: fill the evidence gap with unsupported prose
claim FDA received or accepted the response without verified external evidence
